rules.title: ⚠️ Update now — this version can freeze or crash when you open a channel
rules.message: You are on PremiumTV {version}. This build has a serious bug: opening a channel can leave the picture frozen on black or crash the app, especially when a channel switches to another server. PremiumTV 1.0.9 fixes it — please update right away. Tap “Get 1.0.9 now” and use Settings → App updates; if it wrongly says you are up to date, install PremiumTV-1.0.9.apk by hand from the address below. It installs over this build and keeps your settings and favorites.
rules.surprise: Why Settings may say “up to date”: this build still thinks 1.0.9 is a copy of itself, so the in-app check can miss the fix — the manual install below is the sure path. From 1.0.9 on there are no more “V patches”: every fix is simply the next version, and the app updates itself again.

rules.title: This preview is retired — install PremiumTV {newest}
rules.message: You are on PremiumTV {version}. The 1.1.x preview channel has been removed: its downloads are gone, it receives no more support, and it is not the stable app. Install stable {newest} from the download page. On Android it installs over this preview with no uninstall; on Mac the DMG replaces this copy.
rules.surprise: {newest} is the current stable: the category list with its own sort, the side player, the revamped Live Events tab with live checks, plus the animated loading screen and 11-check bug detection — and from 1.0.9 on, every fix is simply the next version, no more V patches.

rules.title: PremiumTV {newest} is ready — you are on {version}
rules.message: You are on PremiumTV {version}, and a newer stable release is waiting. Open Settings → App updates and press Check for update, then Download update and Install update. It downloads once, verifies against the release SHA-256 file, and installs over this build. Support for builds below {newest} ends {support_ends}, so update before then to keep receiving channel and guide refreshes.
rules.surprise: The newest stable brings the all-new look: categories as a sorted list with their own pages, the side player for watching while you browse, a Live Events tab that checks which games are still live, the animated loading screen and hardened bug detection — and 1.0.9 fixes channels freezing or crashing when opened. From 1.0.9 on, each fix is just the next version.

after_support_ends.title: Support for PremiumTV {version} ended on {support_ends}
after_support_ends.message: This build no longer receives channel or guide updates. Install {newest} to keep live channels and every future update in-app.
after_support_ends.surprise: Stable {newest} still updates itself: Settings → App updates verifies the installer's SHA-256 and installs it for you.

rules.title: A newer PremiumTV is waiting — and this is the last manual install
rules.message: You are on PremiumTV {version}, and {newest} is waiting on GitHub. Update once and PremiumTV keeps itself current from then on. Support for this build ends {support_ends}.
rules.surprise: Here is the surprise: the newest build updates itself. Settings → App updates checks GitHub, downloads the installer once, verifies it against the release's SHA-256 file and hands it to the normal installer — so you never download an APK or a DMG by hand again.

after_support_ends.title: Support for PremiumTV {version} ended on {support_ends}
after_support_ends.message: This build no longer receives the GitHub channel scrape updates, so its channel list is frozen at {support_ends}. Install the newest release from GitHub to keep getting live channels and every future update in-app.
after_support_ends.surprise: The newest build still updates itself: Settings → App updates checks GitHub, verifies the installer's SHA-256 and installs it for you.
